story.then: According to the venue's own website, Johan Svensson founded Drinksfusion in 2006; the bar is described as Drinksfusion's sister company and sits in a restored building.
story.now: The venue's own website lists live jazz on Thursdays, a live blues night hosted by Blues at The Brewery, vinyl DJ sets on Friday nights from 10pm to 2am, Sunday live sessions and early-evening piano bar sessions. Mondays are listed as private hire.
story.vibe: The venue's own website describes a music bar with vintage furniture and mood lighting, and a lounge with velvet seating by a vintage fireplace and an antique brass gantry and illuminated stained glass. It lists a raised stage with an upright piano and an outdoor terrace.
worth_knowing: Its sister company Drinksfusion has served drinks at Tate galleries, the V&A and the Royal Academy, says the venue's own website.
The DJ booth has two Technics 1210 turntables.
Capacity is 150 in total, according to the venue's own website.
